plugins.title: HD2 Music
plugins.summary: NetEase Cloud Music in the manager: a tab on Quick Deploy 0.25.0 and later, a window of its own before. QR-code, cookie or SMS sign-in; playlists, daily recommendations, private FM, radio and podcasts; playback with seek and synced lyrics, while the mod's in-game player, 2D/3D lyrics and spectrum keep working. FFmpeg is inside the DLL, extracted on first use.
plugins.author: ahe-meow

plugins.title: Lobby Browser
plugins.summary: Helldivers 2's public lobbies as a tab of the manager's window (Quick Deploy 0.25.0 and later) or a window of its own, so you pick the lobby you join instead of the game's random matchmaking: planet, front, difficulty, players, mission, region, SOS, ping, host and age; filters for planet, difficulty, mission, map, variant and region; presets.
plugins.author: ahe-meow
